Agent-Legibility Code Standards
nodes.rationale: The LLM is the primary consumer and code generator for this repository. Code must be structured for deterministic discovery, searchability, and minimal ambiguity.

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: OIDC eliminates static AWS keys in GitHub Secrets. Pipeline matches enterprise CD patterns with a manual approval gate for prod. Hardcoded passwords in git are a security risk.

nodes.label: Carnival Stack Alignment Analysis
nodes.rationale: Avoids a complex hybrid polyglot design which would introduce latency, serialization overhead, and deployment complexity to edge nodes on ships. FastAPI and LangGraph run within a single lightweight Docker container, ideal for shipboard computing nodes.

nodes.label: LLM Supervisor Routing Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Upgrade the supervisor node in the multi-agent backend to perform dynamic routing using AWS Bedrock and LangGraph, with mock fallbacks for local and CI environments.
